note: HAND-AUTHORED by this repo for scripts/eval/onnx-embedder-benchmark.mts. NOT sourced from C-MTEB/T2Retrieval or DuRetrieval — this harness's build session had no path to download/subsample a real HF dataset (see docs/research/20260715-bge-m3-onnx-model-matrix.md §5, which flagged hand-authored fixtures as lower external validity than a real C-MTEB subsample). Treat results against this fixture as a directional signal only, not a published-benchmark number. 25 docs (20 targets + 5 topically-adjacent distractors, e.g. d21 is a second typhoon doc distinct from d1's rain forecast, d25 is a second phone doc distinct from d7's review), 20 queries, one graded-relevant gold doc per query (grade 3), everything else implicitly grade 0.
